'''Aklee Skorba''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SpaceCommNebulaAssassin.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Aklee Skorba]]
Aklee Skorba appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Aklee Skorba was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Nova Orion Main Quest Guide|"Nova Orion" quest series]] introduced in the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]],<ref name="SWG:TR" /> released on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="C8">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
